gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-noto-san: Love Ya Like A Sister draws round letters like bent wire, loud and low. Noto Sans Mro sits beneath it with dense, tall-looking words and generous openings into every letter, which is the quality that holds the two together.
Neon glass, then plain sense. Love Ya Like A Sister has tube-like strokes that glow with bold personality, while Noto Sans Old Italic stays quiet, with little gap between x-height and cap height.
Noto Sans Tai Viet has short ascenders and a tall x-height, with terminals pulled back from each curve. Love Ya Like A Sister brings heft.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-batak: Wide, restless, a bit rebellious. Offside is best at tracked-out display lettering with curves that refuse to close, while Noto Sans Batak is best at sturdy, tall lowercase with a wide-open e.
